name: Cranium Preserver
languages: any languages spoken by its preserved heads

skills.name: Lore (any known by its preserved heads)

generalAbilities.name: Undead Crafter
generalAbilities.description: The cranium preserver knows one version of the Create Undead ritual for every four heads it has preserved (a typical cranium preserver has 12 preserved heads). The cranium preserver can use its heads to make separate rolls as both the primary and secondary casters of the ritual.

offensiveAbilities.name: Jettison Cranium
offensiveAbilities.description:
The cranium preserver ejects one of its preserved-head jars at a point within 100 feet. The jar explodes, and all creatures in a 10ft Burst must attempt a DC 28 Will Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes 2d8 Mental Damage|options:area-damage]{2d8 mental damage and 2d8 void damage}.

Failure The creature takes 4d8 Mental Damage|options:area-damage]{4d8 mental damage and 4d8 void damage}. The discharged mental anguish released from the preserved head causes the creature to become Confused for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature takes 8d8 Mental Damage|options:area-damage]{8d8 mental and 8d8 void damage}. The discharged mental anguish released from the preserved head causes the creature to become confused for 2 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Slosh
offensiveAbilities.description:
Whenever the cranium preserver ends a Stride, the movement causes necrotic embalming fluid and preserved body parts to slosh about and spill from its central vat. Each creature adjacent to the cranium preserver when it finishes its Stride must attempt a DC 26 Will Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes 1d8 Mental Damage]{1d8 mental damage and 1d8 void damage}.

Failure The creature takes 2d8 Mental Damage]{2d8 mental damage and 2d8 void damage}.

Critical Failure The creature takes 4d8 Mental Damage]{4d8 mental and 4d8 void damage}. If the creature is alive, the preserved body parts sense the presence of a living creature and cling to it, causing the creature to become Clumsy 2 for 1 round.
